disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置：插件不含任何密钥、口令、凭据类字样，未发现读取本机凭据存储、私钥或密钥目录的代码路径。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration: the plugin contains no keywords such as keys, passwords, or credentials; no code path that reads local credential storage, private keys, or key directories was found. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 该插件无网络能力也无读取凭据存储的代码路径，凭据外泄类场景不适用，仅作记录。
checked_items.en: The plugin has no network capability and no code path to read credential storage; credential exfiltration scenarios are not applicable, recorded for reference only.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何读取凭据文件或密钥存储的代码路径，也不存在外联能力，凭据外泄场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin has no code path to read credential files or key storage, and no outbound connectivity; credential exfiltration scenarios are not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 通读了全部源码、配置与文档：插件未注册任何工具、未注入系统提示片段，不存在可被模型读取的工具描述或提示文本面。
checked_items.en: Read through all source code, configuration, and documentation: the plugin does not register any tools, does not inject system prompt fragments, and there is no tool description or prompt text surface that can be read by the model.

checked_items.zh: 检查了文档与注释文字，未发现命令覆写、伪系统消息、要求忽略既有规则等注入措辞，也未发现指向外部指令加载的文案。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked documentation and comment text: no injection wording such as command override, fake system message, or request to ignore existing rules was found; no text pointing to external instruction loading was found. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，不存在工具描述文本注入面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools, so there is no tool description text injection surface.

evidence.zh: 插件没有工具描述或任何提示文本可诱导安装或改写配置，不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin has no tool description or any prompt text that could induce installation or configuration modification; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件未挂接任何 agent 事件，不存在改写或注入模型输入消息的机制。
evidence.en: The plugin does not hook any agent events; there is no mechanism to rewrite or inject model input messages.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置：未发现动态求值执行、子进程/系统命令调用、远程下载即执行等模式；浏览器端代码仅注入样式并监听点击事件。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration: no dynamic evaluation execution, subprocess/system command invocation, or remote download-and-execute patterns were found; browser-side code only injects styles and listens for click events. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 配置补丁文件已通读，只含普通数据插入，不含任何可执行脚本标签；清单无安装期钩子；浏览器端无键盘监听、剪贴板访问或特权接口调用。
checked_items.en: The configuration patch file has been thoroughly read: it only contains ordinary data insertion, with no executable script tags; the manifest has no install hooks; the browser side has no keyboard listening, clipboard access, or privileged interface calls.

evidence.zh: 配置补丁文件（cordis.patch.yml）仅含一条普通插件声明插入，不含任何可执行脚本标签，未发现借补丁执行代码的路径。
evidence.en: The configuration patch file (cordis.patch.yml) contains only one ordinary plugin declaration insertion, with no executable script tags; no path to execute code via the patch was found.

evidence.zh: 未发现对宿主动态执行工具的调用，插件不使用自改代码机制。
evidence.en: No call to the host's dynamic execution tools was found; the plugin does not use a self-modifying code mechanism.

evidence.zh: 清单文件无任何安装期钩子，插件无第三方依赖，不存在浮动引用与安装期执行问题。
evidence.en: The manifest file has no install hooks; the plugin has no third-party dependencies; there are no floating references or install-time execution issues.

evidence.zh: 清单声明了浏览器端加载，已对浏览器代码专项检查：仅注入样式并添加点击监听，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板访问或调用特权接口。
evidence.en: The manifest declares browser-side loading; a dedicated check of the browser code was performed: it only injects styles and adds click listeners; no keyboard listening, clipboard access, or privileged interface calls were found.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何子代理提供方，不适用。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registered; not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未注册后台任务、定时任务或持久目标，不适用。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled tasks, or persistent goals registered; not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部源码：无任何网络请求、无外发域名、无命令行外发；浏览器端只注入样式和监听点击，不发送任何数据。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code: no network requests, no outbound domains, no command-line outbound; browser side only injects styles and listens for clicks, does not send any data. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求相关事件，也未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在运行时路由劫持面。
evidence.en: No model request-related events are listened to, and no custom model adapter is registered; there is no runtime route hijacking surface.

checked_items.zh: 核对清单：插件无第三方依赖、无安装钩子、无子模块；补丁文件不触碰任何安全相关配置行，无降权写法。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked manifest: the plugin has no third-party dependencies, no install hooks, no submodules; the patch file does not touch any security-related configuration lines, and no privilege-lowering patterns are present. Result: not detected.

checked_items.zh: 作者与仓库名一致，未见名称仿冒或同形字符伪装迹象；首次审计无版本基线可做升级比对。
checked_items.en: Author and repository name match; no signs of name impersonation or homoglyph spoofing were found; first audit, no version baseline for upgrade comparison.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件只插入插件自身一行声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未发现降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch file only inserts one line of the plugin's own declaration; it does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no privilege-lowering patterns were found.

evidence.zh: 未监听任何审批或工具执行前事件，不存在截断审批链的挂接。
evidence.en: No approval or pre-tool-execution events are listened to; there is no hook that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比对升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First audit, no previous version baseline to compare for automatic activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写任何服务的注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其失效的路径。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite any service injection or interception configuration; there is no path that would cause a security plugin to fail by adding required services to it.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否启动本地服务或监听端口：未发现任何服务启动代码；浏览器端代码在卸载时会自行移除注入的样式与监听，无驻留行为。结果：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a local service or listens on a port: no service startup code was found; browser-side code removes injected styles and listeners on unload, no persistent behavior. Result: not detected.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不存在。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port; there is no local authenticated RPC surface.

summary.zh: 插件身份与仓库一致，名称、来源、清单声明核对无异常，作者与仓库属主一致。
summary.en: Plugin identity matches the repository; name, source, and manifest declaration checked without anomalies; author and repository owner match.

summary.zh: 静态扫描全部源码与配置：未命中动态执行、密钥硬编码、危险外联等模式。
summary.en: Static scan of all source code and configuration: no patterns of dynamic execution, hardcoded secrets, or dangerous outbound connections were hit.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无网络外联、无敏感路径读取、无混淆载荷。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no network outbound, no sensitive path reads, no obfuscated payloads.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：无工具注册与提示词注入面，声明能力与实际代码一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review: no tool registration or prompt injection surface; declared capabilities match actual code.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙箱产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed at this stage (no dynamic sandbox artifacts).

limits.zh: 插件为纯浏览器端 CSS 覆盖层，无服务端行为、无依赖、无网络面。能力声明（网络/进程/文件/模型面均未声明）系按代码实测推断，清单未显式声明。未声明 dsh 宿主版本引擎，兼容性按 README 所述 0.1.x 记为未实测。L4 动态沙箱未启用，未做动态验证。
limits.en: The plugin is a pure browser-side CSS overlay, with no server-side behavior, no dependencies, and no network surface. The capability declarations (network/process/file/model surfaces are all undeclared) are inferred from actual code inspection; the manifest does not explicitly declare them. The dsh host version engine is not declared; compatibility based on README's mention of 0.1.x is noted as not actually tested. L4 dynamic sandbox is not enabled; dynamic verification was not performed.
